entities.name: Omarthis
entities.description: Naga from Tarkir who absorbed Ugin's essence to wield Ghostfire magic and has partly turned into a spirit.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Spirit Dragon whose former crucible Omarthis dwells in; Omarthis absorbed his essence.

entities.name: Ghostfire
entities.description: Forbidden magic Omarthis has tapped into.

events.summary: Omarthis absorbs enough of Ugin's essence to wield ghostly magic and partly turns into a spirit.
events.quote: Omarthis has absorbed enough of the essence of the Spirit Dragon
